meta.title: grid-backtest-core capability matrix vs grid-trading research needs
meta.generated_for: Deep technical, strategic and market analysis

capabilities.evidence: models.OrderType.LIMIT; engine._simulate_fills_for_candle (engine.py:542-550) fills BUY at price if low<=price, SELL if high>=price
capabilities.missing: No queue position, no liquidity check, fills are all-or-nothing
capabilities.recommendation: Add a fill model abstraction with optional volume-participation cap and conservative intrabar fill option

capabilities.evidence: config.trading_fee_pct is a single rate applied to every fill (engine.py:179, 456)
capabilities.missing: Limit (maker) vs market (taker) fees; fee tiers; rebates
capabilities.recommendation: Split into maker_fee_pct / taker_fee_pct; charge maker on LIMIT fills, taker on MARKET/stop fills

capabilities.evidence: _simulate_fills_for_candle records one full-qty fill per order; no residual handling
capabilities.missing: Volume-aware partials, residual order persistence
capabilities.recommendation: Allow fill qty = min(order.qty, participation_rate*candle.volume); keep residual open

capabilities.evidence: Engine is candle-driven only (engine._to_candles). No tick path
capabilities.missing: Tick/L2 replay; sub-bar sequencing
capabilities.recommendation: Document OHLCV limitation; optionally support a finer auxiliary series for fill sequencing

capabilities.evidence: Orders placed in on_candle for bar N are matched against the SAME bar N OHLC (documented engine.py:516-520). No intrabar ordering between simultaneous buy/sell touches
capabilities.missing: Pessimistic / conservative fill mode; lookahead-within-bar guard
capabilities.recommendation: Add config flag: fill orders only from bar N+1, and resolve buy-before-sell ambiguity by worst-case ordering

capabilities.evidence: config.slippage_pct applied to MARKET fills only (engine.py:539-541); LIMIT fills have zero slippage; no spread
capabilities.missing: Spread, slippage on stops, volatility/volume-scaled slippage
capabilities.recommendation: Model bid/ask spread and apply slippage to stop/forced-exit fills

capabilities.evidence: SimpleGridStrategy builds levels, seeds buys below / sells above, replaces filled rung with neighbor (grid_simple.py:213-257)
capabilities.missing: Replenish original rung after a round-trip; configurable ladder refill policy
capabilities.recommendation: Add policy to re-arm the original level after the paired close completes

capabilities.evidence: _base_inventory_cache, FIFO position queue, AccountState (engine.py:90-92, 575-668)
capabilities.missing: Inventory caps as a first-class risk control
capabilities.recommendation: Add max_base_inventory / max_notional_exposure guardrails enforced in constraints

capabilities.evidence: Reservations lock funds for open orders; constraints skip/resize on insufficient funds (execution/)
capabilities.missing: Per-grid budget, fixed-fraction sizing, compounding control
capabilities.recommendation: Add allocation policy (fixed qty vs fixed quote vs % equity per rung)

capabilities.evidence: Spot-only; AccountState has no margin fields used; bootstrap only buys base
capabilities.missing: Initial/maintenance margin, borrow, funding rate
capabilities.recommendation: Introduce a MarginModel; required to represent futures grids accurately

capabilities.evidence: No margin engine, no forced-liquidation path
capabilities.missing: Maintenance-margin liquidation, bankruptcy price
capabilities.recommendation: Add liquidation check per bar once margin model exists; critical for leveraged grid honesty

capabilities.evidence: PositionSide.SHORT enum exists but engine only opens LONG positions (engine.py:576-590); neutral bootstrap only buys base
capabilities.missing: Short legs, true direction-neutral grid
capabilities.recommendation: Implement short position lifecycle and a neutral grid that can short above mid

capabilities.evidence: SLTPPolicy percent/ATR (sltp.py); GRID_EXIT flattens, but exit fills at candle.close not at the stop/target price (engine._force_flatten_and_cancel:450)
capabilities.missing: Fill at the actual SL/TP trigger price; gap handling
capabilities.recommendation: Execute forced exits at the trigger price (with slippage), not the bar close

capabilities.evidence: DynamicGridStrategy + RangePolicy/SpacingPolicy/RecenterPolicy (ATR/percent, band-break/time) (grid_dynamic.py)
capabilities.missing: Inventory-aware recentering (recenter cancels orders but leaves inventory unmanaged)
capabilities.recommendation: On recenter, reconcile open inventory against the new ladder; optionally rebalance

capabilities.evidence: BacktestEngine is single symbol/strategy (engine.py:48-72)
capabilities.missing: Shared portfolio across symbols, correlation, cross-margin
capabilities.recommendation: Add a portfolio layer running N engines against one cash account

capabilities.evidence: GridResearchRunner (ProcessPoolExecutor) + grid_search_fast (Numba) (research/)
capabilities.missing: Sweep result persistence/version, overfitting controls
capabilities.recommendation: Couple sweeps with train/test split and deflated-Sharpe selection

capabilities.evidence: No rolling train/test window orchestration in research/
capabilities.missing: Anchored/rolling walk-forward, out-of-sample scoring
capabilities.recommendation: Add WalkForwardRunner wrapping GridResearchRunner over time slices

capabilities.evidence: No resampling/bootstrap or parameter-perturbation tooling
capabilities.missing: Trade/return bootstrap, path simulation, parameter jitter
capabilities.recommendation: Add Monte Carlo of trade sequence + start-date sensitivity reporting

capabilities.evidence: metrics registry; repository writes summary.json/trades.csv/equity_curve.csv; print_result_summary (results/)
capabilities.missing: Visual HTML/PDF report, drawdown chart, per-rung analytics
capabilities.recommendation: Add a report renderer (HTML) consuming BacktestResult; this is also the monetizable artifact

capabilities.evidence: Buy & hold benchmark computed (benchmarks.py; engine.py:226-237)
capabilities.missing: Risk-adjusted alpha, multiple benchmarks, DCA benchmark
capabilities.recommendation: Add DCA and 50/50 rebalanced benchmarks plus alpha/beta

capabilities.evidence: max_drawdown(_pct) on per-candle CLOSE equity (metrics.py:52-78); intrabar lows ignored
capabilities.missing: Intrabar drawdown, drawdown duration, underwater curve, recovery time
capabilities.recommendation: Compute DD on intrabar lows; add time-in-drawdown and recovery metrics

capabilities.evidence: Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar present but annualised from median candle interval (metrics.py:132-202); per-candle returns inflate factor for 1m data
capabilities.missing: Deflated Sharpe, fee/turnover-aware metrics, exposure-adjusted return
capabilities.recommendation: Add deflated Sharpe; annualise on a sane periodicity; report turnover and fee drag

capabilities.evidence: Realized PnL net of fees only; no tax-lot or wash-sale logic
capabilities.missing: Tax lots, jurisdiction rules
capabilities.recommendation: Out of scope for research; only needed for a retail accounting product

capabilities.evidence: FastBacktestEngine/_numba_engine ignore reservations, constraints, bootstrap, SL/TP, filters, ATR range; dynamic kernel uses only band_pct+interval (engine_fast.py:190-227). No parity tests reference FastBacktestEngine
capabilities.missing: Numerical parity tests; documented feature gap
capabilities.recommendation: Add parity test suite asserting fast == full within tolerance for the supported subset; restrict fast engine to the subset it truly models
